messages:
deploy-bot: starting canary deploy: api=3.1.0 runtime=2.4.1 router=1.8.0 console=0.9.3 -- 10% pods across us-west-2 :rocket:
mira: heads-up — console has a migration that changes session route keys, did we pin router behavior? :eyes:
kirill: we intentionally skipped the route-mapping change for router canary; router still on stable mapping semantics for this canary. runtime change is the risky one (kv-cache key normalization).
rachel: can we confirm API backwards compatibility for session replay endpoints? those call runtime cache keys directly.
sam: quick snippet from router config I'm about to push to canary nodes:
```
feature_flags:
  route_mapping_v2: false
  session_key_normalization: false
```
will push if everyone ✅
mira: thanks — if runtime normalizes keys while console still writes old keys we'll get misses + spurious 500s on replay. watch the console/replay 5xxs closely.
deploy-bot: canary started at 1770001234. metrics dashboard: https://ops.redwood/kanary/1770001234 (latency/calls/5xx)
kirill: monitoring note: I'm tracking cache hit rate and kv key length distribution. alert if cache-hit drops >8% or replay 5xx >1% above baseline.
jenkins-bot: deploy job #6423 passed smoke tests (api smoke ✅, runtime smoke ✅, router smoke ✅)
jess: pinging release-notes: we should include pinned versions and the known compatibility caveat for console replay. I'll draft.
mira: reporting initial canary: console-replay 5xx spiked from 0.4% -> 2.6% on canary nodes, correlate with runtime traces showing missing KV entries. :grimacing:
kirill: that's outside our threshold. recommend immediate rollback of runtime on canary nodes only. prefer to keep api/router/console at canary target but revert runtime to 2.4.0.
rachel: agree. runtime rollback only — console and router untouched. that will preserve new API features we need to validate separately.
sam: rollback command ready:
```
# rollback runtime on canary subset
kubectl -n production set image deploy/runtime runtime=runtime:2.4.0 --selector=canary=true
```
will run in 30s unless someone yells stop.
jess: tagging docs: add note about 'runtime 2.4.1 KV normalization disabled for canary; pinned runtime 2.4.0 for now' in release notes draft.
deploy-bot: runtime rollback initiated at 1770001800 by sam (job 6424). status: rolling back 3/3 canary pods.
mira: watching metrics; cache-hit recovering on canary nodes, replay 5xx back to 0.5% — good.
kirill: we'll re-open a follow-up PR to make runtime KV normalization opt-in via feature flag and add an integration test for console replay keys.
jess: for customer communication: draft line — "We delayed the global rollout of runtime 2.4.1 due to a cache compatibility issue affecting session replay; customers on Dedicated can pin runtime to 2.4.0. Full rollout tentatively scheduled Tue 06:00 UTC pending tests"
rachel: proposal for full rollout window: Tue 06:00 UTC (low traffic) + 2-hour change window + ability to rollback within 15m. agreed?
sam: +1
mira: +1
kirill: i'll own the follow-up PR and the canary retest checklist.
deploy-bot: thread closed (canary adjusted) — reopening if any regression. :white_check_mark:
